patch_description: Proposed ANSATZ_SPEC crossover: merge the strengths of the two reference seeds by keeping per-group (corner/edge/center) symmetry-based parameter sharing for pre/post RZ and RY, and combining a ring entangler on the outer qubits with a parametric hub entangler that uses CRZ gates from center to edges. This keeps the parameter budget modest (11 unique per-block parameters, 66 total with 3 uploads and 2 repeats) while enabling a richer entangling structure than the baseline and leveraging symmetry-inspired sharing. The ring uses CRX gates on the outer ring, while the hub uses CRZ gates from the center to edge qubits, matching the more promising combination seen in cross-over designs. This should improve validation/train dynamics by increasing expressivity without exploding parameter count.
